# IPCC Report Portal

> The official repository for the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change's Sixth Assessment Report, providing comprehensive climate science assessments, synthesis findings, and policy guidance.

report.ipcc.ch hosts the IPCC's AR6 Synthesis Report, the authoritative assessment of climate change science, impacts, and mitigation/adaptation strategies. The site aggregates findings from multiple working groups and provides resources for policymakers, scientists, and the public.

## Key Topics

- IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change)
- AR6 Synthesis Report
- Sixth Assessment Report
- Summary for Policymakers
- Climate Change Assessment
- Climate Mitigation and Adaptation
- Working Groups
- Climate Science
- Climate Policy
- Headline Statements
- Climate Change 2023
- Emissions
- Global Climate Report

## Core Reports and Assessments

- [IPCC Homepage](https://report.ipcc.ch/): Main IPCC homepage for Sixth Assessment Report and climate science resources
- [AR6 Synthesis Report Landing Page](https://report.ipcc.ch/ar6syr/): AR6 Synthesis Report landing page with official climate change assessment
- [AR6 Synthesis Report Index](https://report.ipcc.ch/ar6syr/index.html): AR6 Synthesis Report index page with climate assessment and policymakers summary

## Key Findings and Data

- [Headline Findings](https://report.ipcc.ch/ar6syr/headline.html): AR6 headline findings on climate mitigation, adaptation, and emissions
- [Figures and Visualizations](https://report.ipcc.ch/ar6syr/figures.html): AR6 Synthesis Report figures and visualizations for climate data
